opening.argument: The presentation solicits paid participation through a $99 membership and pools priced from $500 to $3,500, promising income over 1,000 days. It presents BitClub as mining-based, stating, “The first part is business and physical, it's dry, quite calculate. It's mining firms.” It also claims to increase participants’ Bitcoin mining and daily income, while describing a binary structure in which members “only have to register two people in your first line.” Rewards are tied to invited people and team members purchasing pools, with cycles generated when the lines fill. Alongside these recruitment-linked payments and percentage-based bonuses, viewers are told they may earn up to $2,000 per day and are directed to register with sponsor assistance. The available evidence does not establish that those returns or support were delivered.
